programme.desc: L'histoire de Ted Kennedy et de son accident de voiture en 1969 qui a coûté la vie à Mary Jo Kopechne.

programme.title: Rememory
programme.desc: La mort suspecte de Gordon, créateur de la machine Rememory, lance une enquête pour percer le mystère.

programme.title: Le Duel
programme.desc: Un Texas Ranger enquête sur une série de décès inexpliqués dans une ville appelée Helena.

programme.title: Le Secret des Kennedy
programme.desc: L'histoire de Ted Kennedy et de son accident de voiture en 1969 qui a coûté la vie à Mary Jo Kopechne.

programme.title: Good Advice
programme.desc: Ryan Turner est un jeune banquier-investisseur qui connaît un succès incomparable. Ryan court beaucoup trop les jupons et couche régulièrement avec ses clientes, y compris, malheureusement pour lui, Veronica Simpson, la femme de son plus important client, Donald Simpson.

programme.title: November Criminals
programme.desc: Deux amis bientôt étudiants universitaires (Ansel Elgort et Chloë Grace Moretz) tombent amoureux l'un de l'autre. Mais après le meurtre mystérieux de leur camarade de classe, ils défient les autorités de découvrir la vérité.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Prêt à tout pour trouver un sujet d'article intéressant, un journaliste suit une prostituée diplômée de Stanford et s'introduit dans le monde des escorts girls de luxe.

programme.title: The Best Offer
programme.desc: Virgil Oldman, un expert en art reclus, acquiert des tableaux inestimables en trompant leurs propriétaires sur leur valeur. Engagé par la mystérieuse Claire Ibbetson pour évaluer son patrimoine, Virgil découvre des pièces mécaniques et demande l'aide de son ami Robert pour les réassembler.

programme.title: Une Pluie sans Fin
programme.desc: Un homme licencié d'une aciérie veut désespérément traquer un tueur en série dans une petite ville du sud de la Chine.

programme.title: À Ceux qui Nous Ont Offensés
programme.desc: Vivants en parias à la périphérie du Gloucestershire, trois générations de Cutler, la célèbre famille de criminels professionnels, passent leur temps à planifier leur prochain casse et à se moquer de la police. Mais de plus en plus, Chad, l'aîné, qui est sous la coupe de Colby, le patriarche de la famille et maître des opérations, se retrouve tiraillé entre son désir de mener une vie tranquille avec sa femme et son fils, loin du crime, et le respect mêlé de crainte qu'il éprouve pour son père. Lorsque Colby élabore un plan visant une collection d'art privée, une vie entière de mauvaises décisions, de violence insensée et de criminalité commence à s'effondrer, soulignant le fait que Chad, digne fils et héritier de son père, doit faire un choix. Chad trouvera-t-il le courage de s'affirmer et de prendre son envol, ou détruira-t-il la famille ? Après tout, il n'en a qu'une.

programme.title: Bons baisers de Grèce
programme.desc: Vanessa est fiancée à Tim et le mariage est pour bientôt. Mais lorsqu'il part en Grèce pour affaires, il n'est soudain plus aussi enthousiaste à l'idée d'épouser Vanessa. Il annule donc le mariage, mais Vanessa ne veut pas le prendre à la légère : elle le suit sur l'île grecque de Santorin, où les choses se passent très différemment de ce qui était prévu, car non seulement il a trouvé son nouveau bonheur ici, mais elle semble aussi avoir pris goût au Janis local.

programme.title: Un p'tit Gars de Ménilmontant
programme.desc: Jo, interprété par Olivier Marchal, sort de prison après avoir purgé une peine de 15 ans pour un vol important. Tout a changé dans son ancien quartier parisien : de nouveaux gangs avec de nouveaux chefs lui posent de nouveaux défis. Il découvre qu'il a un fils et son retour lui cause des ennuis indésirables.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: Une adaptation de l'histoire de Lizzie Borden, accusée du double meurtre de son père et de sa belle-mère.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: 1ère Classe Barrows
programme.desc: Peu après le débarquement, une patrouille anglaise égarée derrière les lignes énemies est décimée.

programme.title: Dangereuse proposition
programme.desc: Un flic a besoin d'une femme flic pour se faire passer pour sa femme pour se rapprocher d'un patron du crime

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Riche, beau et célèbre, Jerry Maguire, agent des stars du sport americain, l'est. Mais sa vie mondaine et factice lui pèse, et une nuit il se remet en question dans une note qu'il rédige, où il tente de définir le sens qu'il voudrait donner à sa vie. Cette note va provoquer son licenciement et tous ses amis vont le trahir.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Pour impressionner sa petite amie Vanessa et a la suite d'un quiproquo, Sonny, celibataire endurci, fait croire qu'il est le pere naturel de Julian, un jeune garcon de cinq ans qu'il adopte. C'est la catastrophe et l'enfer des nuits detruites, des seances insupportables de calins sans parler de la chanson du Kangourou, qui font decouvrir a Sony un monde qu'il ignorait totalement.

programme.title: Dick
programme.desc: Alors qu'elles visitent la Maison Blanche, Betsy et Arlene, deux adolescentes, tombent par hasard sur une pièce recelant les secrets du Président Nixon. Pour découvrir ce qu'elles savent vraiment, « Richard le truqueur » les nomme promeneuses de chien officielles. Soudain les filles se retrouvent impliquées dans la fameuse intrigue politique du Watergate. Alors que le duo plonge dans l'aventure, même les hommes du Président ne pourront les empêcher de changer le cours de l'histoire.

programme.title: Ricki And The Flash
programme.desc: Une Meryl Streep comme vous ne l'aviez jamais vue, en chanteuse-guitariste qui déchire, dans Ricki and the Flash, réalisé par Jonathan Demme, récompensé par un Oscar, avec un scénario de Diablo Cody, récompensé par un Academy Award. Dans un film original et électrisant, plein de performances musicales, Streep joue Ricki Rendazzo, une guitariste qui a fait énormément d'erreurs alors qu'elle voulait poursuivre son rêve dans le monde du rock 'n' roll. De retour chez elle, Ricki essaie de se faire pardonner et d'arranger les choses alors qu'elle fait face à la musique avec sa famille.

programme.title: Braquage à New York
programme.desc: Henry, un percepteur de péage, est injustement emprisonné après avoir aidé sans le savoir des amis à commettre un vol de banque. En prison, il se lie d'amitié avec Max, un escroc charmant. Après avoir purgé sa peine, Henry découvre un vieux tunnel reliant la banque à un théâtre.

programme.title: Art School Confidential
programme.desc: Passionné par le dessin depuis son enfance, le jeune Jérome s'inscrit dans une école d'art, à Strathmore. Alors qu'il apprend peu à peu comment fonctionne le monde des artistes, un tueur en série va semer la panique au sein de l'établissement.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes & John Watson
programme.desc: Les frangins malgré eux se retrouvent. Cette fois, ils interprètent le plus grand détective du monde et son fidèle acolyte et biographe. Will Ferrell et John C. Reilly jouent Holmes et Watson. Ensemble, ils élucident un meurtre à Buckingham Palace.

programme.title: Van Wilder: The Rise of Taj
programme.desc: Après avoir découvert, grâce à son légendaire mentor Van Wilder, les plaisirs les plus charnels, Taj Badalandabad (Kal Penn) part en Angleterre étudier à la prestigieuse Université de Camford.

programme.title: La Fureur des Apaches
programme.desc: Un jeune officier de cavalerie est chargé d'arrêter une bande d'Apaches qui terrorisent la campagne.

programme.title: Gentleman Killer
programme.desc: Une ville frontalière devient l'objet de troubles politiques entre les États-Unis et le Mexique lorsqu'un bandit commence à tuer autant de soldats américains qu'il le peut.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Les efforts conjoints du gouvernement américain et de la nation comanche pour négocier un traité de paix sont sabotés par des Indiens renégats.

programme.title: Arizona Bill
programme.desc: Un cavalier solitaire rencontre un soldat mourant, qui lui remet un papier autorisant le versement de 150 000 dollars à l'armée américaine.

programme.title: Le désert rouge
programme.desc: Deux hommes trouvent un bébé abandonné et se disputent la propriété de l'enfant, ce qui entraîne une rivalité qui durera toute la vie.

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: Le commandant d'un fort texan pendant la guerre civile refuse de se rendre aux Nordistes et tente d'acheter la fille du chef de la tribu indienne locale.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Retour a Legend City
programme.desc: Enfant, il a vu son père prédicateur se faire assassiner. En tant que soldat, il a été témoin des horreurs de la guerre civile. Aujourd'hui, le chasseur de primes James Conners est de retour à Legend, au Nouveau-Mexique, pour capturer le baron terrien psychotique qui a détruit son enfance.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: The House At The End Of Time
programme.desc: Dulce est une jeune mère qui a des hallucinations. Elle voit des apparitions dans sa maison, qui un jour déclenche la prophétie et tue tous les habitants sauf elle. Trente ans plus tard, elle se réinstalle dans sa demeure afin d'élucider le mystère.

programme.title: Grindstone road
programme.desc: Il y a quelques mois, Hannah Sloan (Fairuza Balk) a été victime d'un terrible accident de voiture qui a plongé son fils Daniel dans un coma prolongé. Dans l'espoir de mettre cette tragédie derrière eux, Hannah et son mari Graham (Greg Bryk) emménagent dans la ferme qu'ils viennent d'acheter. Rongée par la culpabilité et le sentiment de responsabilité vis-à-vis de l'état de son fils, Hannah se tourne vers les antidépresseurs qui lui ont été prescrits pour trouver du réconfort. Peu après leur emménagement dans leur nouvelle maison, Hannah commence à être témoin d'événements étranges et mystérieux, ce qui inquiète de plus en plus Graham quant à la quantité de médicaments qu'elle prend. Hannah est-elle en train de perdre la raison, ou y a-t-il des forces surnaturelles à l'œuvre ?

programme.title: Black circle
programme.desc: La vie de deux sœurs change radicalement, depuis qu'elles ont été hypnotisées par un disque vinyle mystique des années 1970.

programme.title: Le Lac Maudit
programme.desc: Une famille en vacances renverse la situation face à un tireur de masse qui prétend combattre des forces démoniaques.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: Le monde n'a pas de limite pour David Rice, qui peut se téléporter à souhait, jusqu'au jour où il se fait repérer par les paladins, une organisation secrète qui traque les Jumpers.

programme.title: Les derniers citoyens
programme.desc: Dans un monde postapocalyptique gangréné par des gangs sanguinaires, Nina (Kate Bosworth) et Mark (Tyler Hoechlin) arpentent des contrées sans foi ni loi pour trouver un refuge et, à bout de souffle, doivent rester solidaires pour survivre.

programme.title: Les dieux des profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une mission audacieuse conduit une équipe de sous-marin en eaux profondes dans une mystérieuse ouverture au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent son ancienne race d'êtres d'un autre monde...

programme.title: UFO
programme.desc: Une horde d'OVNIS envahit le ciel de Londres dans le but d'anéantir toute forme de vie humaine.

programme.title: 2012 Supernova
programme.desc: Face à une supernova menaçant la Terre, un astrophysicien élabore un plan désespéré pour stopper les radiations.

programme.title: Helix Densho
programme.desc: Michael tente de contrôler ses sœurs et l'abbaye, tandis qu'Alan se méfie de plus en plus de Peter.

programme.title: Les Prédateurs Justice sur terre
programme.desc: Un tueur en série vise la communauté homosexuelle d'un immeuble. Un archange venu étudier le Mal entre dans la lutte.

programme.title: The Outpost Rien ne dure éternellement
programme.desc: Talon et ses amis livrent l'ultime bataille contre les dieux, pendant que Janzo, Wren et Munt tentent de sauver les Kahvi.

programme.title: Red : Werewolf hunter
programme.desc: Mordue par un loup-garou, la descendante du Petit Chaperon Rouge doit protéger son fiancé de sa famille de chasseurs.

programme.title: Les Prédateurs Justice sur terre
programme.desc: Un tueur en série vise la communauté homosexuelle d'un immeuble. Un archange venu étudier le Mal entre dans la lutte.

programme.title: Helix Densho
programme.desc: Michael tente de contrôler ses sœurs et l'abbaye, tandis qu'Alan se méfie de plus en plus de Peter.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre Tirs croisés
programme.desc: À l'approche des élections, Liam soupçonne Zo'or de vouloir faire assassiner Jonathan Doors lors du débat final.

programme.title: Le Pacte Du Mal
programme.desc: Diego, médecin endurci face à la douleur, est tenu pour responsable après la tentative de suicide de sa patiente Sara.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double d'elle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: Dementia
programme.desc: Un vétéran atteint de démence découvre que son infirmière cache de terribles secrets.

programme.title: Myn Bala, Les Guerriers de la Steppe
programme.desc: Kazakhstan, 1729. Les Dzungars, une tribu de Mongols, avance rapidement à travers les Steppes.

programme.title: Jungle Run
programme.desc: Sans nouvelles de leur père disparu en Amazonie, Amanda et son frère partent à sa recherche.

programme.title: Jurassic Domination
programme.desc: Deux dinosaures conçus dans un laboratoire militaire attaquent une petite ville de montagne.

programme.title: Jurassic Planet
programme.desc: Un vaisseau spatial s'écrase sur une planète inconnue peuplée de dinosaures.

programme.title: La Malédiction des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Après des décennies de silence, des esprits malveillants refont surface et terrorisent les habitants de la ville.

programme.title: Land Shark
programme.desc: Qian Cheng a installé un laboratoire de recherche biopharmaceutique au cœur de la jungle. Lorsque les chercheurs modifient l'ADN d'un requin pour développer un nouveau remède contre le cancer, ils créent involontairement un monstre.

programme.title: United States of Leland
programme.desc: Un enseignant essaie de comprendre pourquoi un adolescent a commis un meurtre.

programme.title: How to be
programme.desc: En crise, un jeune Londonien engage un gourou canadien pour devenir son coach de vie personnel.

programme.title: Hot Summer nights
programme.desc: Années 80. Vacances d'été. Un adolescent fait la fête, tombe amoureux, prend des risques..

programme.title: Chloé et Théo
programme.desc: Un Inuit se rend à New York afin d'ouvrir les yeux des gens sur le réchauffement climatique.

programme.title: Breaking And Exiting
programme.desc: En plein cambriolage, Harry rencontre Daisy et décide de la sauver d'elle-même.

programme.title: Rogue agent
programme.desc: Focus sur le parcours Robert Hendy-Freegard. Cet ancien barman s'est fait passer pendant près de dix ans pour un agent des services secrets britanniques. Il parvenait à convaincre ses victimes qu'elles étaient les proies de terroristes de l'IRA.

programme.title: Déchaînés
programme.desc: Alors que les célèbres criminels Gary Tison et Randy Greenwalt s'évadent de prison, leur cavale se transforme rapidement en une sanglante chasse à l'homme.

programme.title: One Night in Miami...
programme.desc: Les idoles américaines Mohamed Ali, Malcolm X, Sam Cooke, et Jim Brown se réunissent pour discuter de leur rôle dans le mouvement des droits civiques.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Une jeune Américaine d'origine coréenne, enlevée et forcée à se prostituer par des trafiquants d'êtres humains, coopère avec ses ravisseurs dans un stratagème désespéré pour survivre.

programme.title: Le suspect idéal
programme.desc: Meurtre atroce : lors d'un interrogatoire, un génie instable retourne la situation face aux flics.

programme.title: Voyeur
programme.desc: Un détective suit secrètement une tueuse en série agissant comme son ange gardien.

programme.title: Marionnette
programme.desc: Une thérapeute perd le contrôle de la réalité face à un garçon affirmant pouvoir contrôler son avenir.

programme.title: Night Walk
programme.desc: Dans cette version moderne de Roméo et Juliette, les amants sont déchirés d'Orient et d'Occident.

programme.title: Dangerous
programme.desc: Après le décès de son frère, un sociopathe en voie de guérison s'installe sur une île éloignée. Cet endroit va bientôt être assiégé par une bande de mercenaires, responsables de la mort de son frère, l'homme va alors opter pour une vengeance implacable...

programme.title: Fight Girls
programme.desc: Un groupe de chanteuses punks est kidnappé dans un quartier sordide. A leur réveil, elles réalisent que certains de leurs membres ont été remplacés par des armes mortelles. Leur unique chance de survie est de s'affronter dans une arène pour divertir les membres d'une secte, assoiffés de sang.

programme.title: Surrounded
programme.desc: À la recherche d'une mine d'or, l'ex-soldate Mo Washington va dans l'Ouest. Une embuscade la force à capturer un bandit. Une lutte dans la nature sauvage s'ensuit. Réalisé par Anthony Mandler, avec Letitia Wright, Jamie Bell et Michael K. Williams.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Becky, 13 ans, est pour le moins contrariée de devoir passer le week-end dans une cabine isolée avec son père et sa nouvelle belle-mère. Cette situation est pourtant le moindre de ses ennuis : un groupe de dangereux criminels tout juste évadés de prison prennent sa famille en otage.

programme.title: L'étranger
programme.desc: Lex Walker apprend que sa fille est morte. Se rendant à Los Angeles pour identifier le corps, il découvre que ce dernier n'est pas celui de sa fille il décide alors de mener son enquête.

programme.title: What Keeps You Alive
programme.desc: Pour leur premier anniversaire de mariage, Jackie emmène Jules dans le coin reculé où son père et elle allaient chasser, quand elle était petite. Personne à la ronde, à part la luxueuse demeure de son amie d'enfance de l'autre côté du lac. Toutes les conditions sont réunies pour un week-end idyllique en amoureuses. Pour une plongée dans l'horreur, aussi.

programme.title: Les Liens du Sang
programme.desc: Un frère et une sœur incapables d'avouer un secret. Une mère qui leur reproche leur ingratitude et leur absence. Un robot d'assistance médicale dysfonctionnel. Le déjeuner est servi !

programme.title: The Belgian Wave
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le journaliste Marc Varenberg et son caméraman disparaissent dans des circonstances mystérieuses alors qu'ils enquêtent sur la Vague Belge (une série d'observations d'Ovni survenus entre 1989 et 1991). Près de 30 ans plus tard, deux webreporters rouvrent l'enquête pour découvrir ce qui s'est réellement passé.

programme.title: Les Dents du Bonheur
programme.desc: Madeleine, huit ans, accompagne sa mère esthéticienne à domicile chez de nouvelles clientes. Arrivée à la maison, elle fait la connaissance d'Eugénie, Constance et Émeraude, qui l'invitent au sous-sol à participer à un cruel jeu de société.

programme.title: Prends Chair
programme.desc: Un adolescent en surpoids est victime de moqueries quotidiennes dans son quartier et même dans sa famille. Son corps devient un exutoire à son mal-être.

programme.title: The Lovers
programme.desc: Au cours d'un dîner romantique, un homme voit sa chair tomber brutalement. Et alors ? La vie continue.

programme.title: What's Behind that Door?
programme.desc: Un couple vit depuis toujours dans une chambre sans portes ni fenêtres. Un jour, sa vie bascule lorsqu'il découvre derrière le papier peint une mystérieuse porte.

programme.title: L'Au-delà
programme.desc: Une jeune femme hérite d'un hôtel à la Nouvelle Orléans. Alors qu'elle entreprend des travaux de rénovation, des phénomènes étranges font de sa vie un véritable enfer.

programme.title: Invisibles
programme.desc: Louise est en rupture. Placardisée au travail, elle se sépare en plus de son compagnon, employé dans la même société. Au moment où elle apprend que son contrat n'est pas reconduit, elle est témoin d'agressions étranges.

programme.title: Rogue Agent
programme.desc: L'histoire de l'escroc Robert Freegard.

programme.title: The Last Wave
programme.desc: Des inondations extrêmes provoquent des tremblements de terre et tsunamis massifs.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Shirin s'installe avec son beau-fils Lucas, hanté par une présence maléfique dans la maison voisine.

programme.title: The Only Child
programme.desc: Une mère soupçonne que son fils n'est plus le même.

programme.title: The Bone Collector
programme.desc: Criminologue de renom devenu tétraplégique, Lincoln Rhyme n'a plus qu'un désir : mourir. Il se convainc néanmoins de reprendre du service quand une effroyable série de crimes s'abat sur New York. Malgré ses réticences, Amelia Donaghy, une jeune recrue, va aider Rhyme. Elle sera ses yeux, ses mains, pour piéger le machiavélique meurtrier...

programme.title: Dragon Eyes
programme.desc: Le quartier de St Jude a sombré dans le chaos et la violence depuis qu'il est devenu l'enjeu d'une lutte sans merci entre deux gangs, celui de Dash et celui d'Antoine. La situation change le jour où arrive en ville un étranger nommé Ryan Hong. L'homme montre d'impressionnantes compétences martiales et il se voit courtisé par les deux clans. Refusant de prendre parti, il s'arrange pour multiplier les confrontations, aidé par son mentor, Tiano. Alors qu'il arrive à rendre confiance aux habitants du quartier, Hong est confronté à monsieur V, le cruel et corrompu chef de la police de la ville. L'affrontement entre les deux hommes devient inévitable...

programme.title: Harcelés
programme.desc: Pour Chris et Lisa, emménager dans leur maison de Lakeview Terrace est un rêve devenu réalité. Pourtant, rapidement, les deux jeunes gens deviennent la cible de leur voisin, qui désapprouve leur relation interraciale. Cet homme strict et austère, père célibataire et policier, s'est autoproclamé responsable de la sécurité du quartier.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: glCuba
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver's personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won't find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy's Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: The Seychelles
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: Menorca
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Peak Performance

programme.title: The Anomaly

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: A tale that will take you back in the past, EK Tha Raja Thi Rani is a dramatic take on the life of royalty. The story revolves around the head of the royal family Ameerkot. The family is headed by a woman, who portrays royalty in all her words and actions. Rajmata wishes the pride and the royalty of her family to always soar up in the sky. In this episode, she is seen eagerly waiting for her son, Rana Indravadhan to arrive home. He is a soldier who had taken part in the World War 2. The scene shifts to Rana Indravadhan, who visits his home. He has visions of the war and how he lost his fellow men in the war. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Tha Rani to learn more about his tale.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Crime Files
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: My Secret,Terrius Ep.4 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). She grows rapidly within the world of intelligence, which had seemed like a totally different world to her, and shows great performance that even surprises the NIS agents.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF's Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly's ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky's own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly's horse wins the race. At Louisville's Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri
programme.desc: Con un grande cast, girato tra Vienna, Londra, Parigi, New York, l'Arizona e Rio de Janeiro, il film racconta quanti incontri, opportunità, scelte e decisioni ci si presentano nel corso di una vita.

programme.title: The Gods
programme.desc: In un moderno Romeo e Giulietta, Mikey James, un imbroglione cresciuto per strada con i suoi due fratelli, va a lavorare per la famiglia Fasano mentre cerca disperatamente di trovare una via d'uscita dal suo stile di vita frenetico.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: Angélique ha 60 anni. Ama ancora le feste, le piacciono ancora gli uomini. Di notte, per guadagnarsi da vivere, gli fa bere in un night club nei pressi del confine con la Germania. Con il passare del tempo, i clienti diventano sempre piu' rari. Ma Michel, suo cliente fisso, è ancora innamorato di lei. Un giorno, chiede a Angélique di sposarlo.

programme.title: Nut Job – Operazione Noccioline
programme.desc: Cosa c'è di più terribile per un roditore di perdere tutte le scorte di cibo per l'inverno? Ma lo scoiattolo Surly ed i suoi amici non si perdono d'animo ed escogitano un piano per svaligiare Noceland, un fornitissimo negozio di noci, nocciole e croccanti di noccioline!

programme.title: Playmobil: The Movie
programme.desc: Quando il fratello minore Charlie scompare inaspettatamente nell'universo magico e animato di PLAYMOBIL®, Marla, sorella maggiore, totalmente impreparata, dovrà mettersi sulle sue tracce per riportarlo a casa...

programme.title: Elle
programme.desc: Un tempo Elle sognava di diventare una cantante famosa, ma ora vive a Los Angeles e lavora per un'etichetta discografica. Un giorno incontra il giovane Ty Parker, una stella del pop. Con l'aiuto dei suoi amici, Elle scoprirà che i sogni possono davvero diventare realtà.

programme.title: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: La vera storia di Robinson Crusoe raccontata dal pappagallo Venerdì che sull'isola è diventato il suo migliore amico.

programme.title: Speriamo che sia femmina
programme.desc: Capolavoro di Monicelli con un cast eccezionale. In un casale della campagna toscana vive in armonia un gruppo di donne. Elena dirige la fattoria, e la domestica Fosca è il vero nume tutelare della casa, che provvede alle necessità di tutte. Fosca si prende cura di sua figlia Immacolata e della nipote di Elena, Martina, figlia di Claudia che, per egoismo, l'ha affidata alla sorella.

programme.title: Le dolci zie
programme.desc: Cult della commedia sexy all'italiana. Il giovane e inesperto Libero vive con il nonno anarchico e mangiapreti che l'ha sottratto alle grinfie di tre zie nubili, bramose di tutela. Con l'aiuto di un sacerdote e dei carabinieri, le zitelle riescono a impossessarsi del ragazzo e lo coprono di lussuria.

programme.title: Giallo
programme.desc: Regia del maestro italiano del brivido Dario Argento. Giallo è un serial killer che uccide donne bellissime di passaggio in città. La sua ultima preda è la giovane modella Celine ma, questa volta, Giallo commette un errore che potrebbe essergli fatale, che metterà sulle sue tracce l'ispettore Enzo Avolfi, affiancato da Linda, la sorella di Celine.

programme.title: Il Re della mala
programme.desc: Molti proiettili volano e diversi corpi cadono per terra senza vita quando un mafioso tedesco e il suo omologo siciliano intraprendono una sanguinosa guerra per conquistare il controllo di Amburgo.

programme.title: Lo sciupafemmine
programme.desc: Peppino, italiano in Brasile, lavora nella ditta del cugino Carlo, prossima al fallimento. Solo un imprenditore tedesco, Lacter, potrebbe salvare l'azienda, così Peppino paga una prostituta perché seduca Lacter fingendo di essere Lucia, la moglie di Carlo. Ma il tedesco ha in realtà già conosciuto Lucia, dando inizio a una spassosa girandola di equivoci.

programme.title: Peccato che sia una canaglia
programme.desc: La vita di Paolo (Marcello Mastroianni), un tranquillo e indolente autista di taxi, viene sconvolta dall'incontro con Lina (Sophia Loren), una bella ragazza, abile in borseggi e piccole truffe. Lina e la sua famiglia, sconclusionata come lei, affascinano Paolo che ce la mette tutta per redimere la ragazza. Con Vittorio De Sica nei panni del Prof. Stroppiani, padre di Lina.

programme.title: L'impiegato
programme.desc: Splendida commedia con Nino Manfredi. Estremamente ligio al lavoro, un giovane impiegato non si concede mai distrazioni di alcun genere, sfogando tutte le sue pulsioni più intime ed i suoi desideri di realizzazione con intensi sogni. Il suo mondo sembra sgretolarsi con l'arrivo di una donna a capo dell'azienda che metterà a soqquadro le sue abitudini. Diretta da Gianni Puccini.

programme.title: Il Mantenuto
programme.desc: Stefano Garbelli, impiegato romano, viene coinvolto dalla prostituta Daniela, che lo indica come suo protettore per difendersi dai magnaccia. Daniela si finge infermiera, suscitando l'interesse di Stefano. Inconsapevolmente, Stefano diventa il suo protettore agli occhi dei rivali e della polizia, che lo convoca al commissariato insieme agli aggressori.

programme.title: Intrigo a Taormina
programme.desc: Gli ospiti di un milionario, a bordo del suo yacht, si trovano invischiati in complessi intrecci romantici.

programme.title: Splendor
programme.desc: Il proprietario, il proiezionista e la maschera di una sala di provincia che sta per chiudere i battenti si abbandonano ai ricordi: ma quando gli operai stanno già schiodando le poltrone...

programme.title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
programme.desc: Sei storie di matrimoni impossibili: tra leggi, ricatti e assurdità burocratiche, uomini e donne si ritrovano intrappolati in legami che non possono sciogliere. Tra manicomio, carcere, divorzio estero e conventi, l'amore si scontra con l'inflessibilità delle istituzioni, generando drammi, equivoci e amara ironia.

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Animali selvatici
programme.desc: Matthias, dopo un litigio, scappa dalla Germania e torna al villaggio d'origine in Transilvania. Qui trova una situazione complicata.

programme.title: Le livre d'image
programme.desc: Jean-Luc Godard intreccia frammenti di film, notizie e suoni in un mosaico visivo e sonoro. Diviso in cinque capitoli, "Le Livre d'image" esplora temi come la guerra, la legge e l'imperialismo, offrendo una meditazione profonda sulla condizione umana e la memoria collettiva.

programme.title: Revanche
programme.desc: L'ex criminale Alex e la sua fidanzata, la prostituta Tamara cercano disperatamente di sfuggire all'ambiente corrotto in cui vivono a Vienna, ma per farlo hanno bisogno di molti soldi. Alex ha un piano: rapinare una banca in un paesino di campagna. Tamara insiste per andare con lui e il ragazzo acconsente con riluttanza. Tutto va esattamente come previsto finché si avvicina Robert, un poliziotto felicemente sposato che vive in una fattoria vicino.

programme.title: Oltre le Colline
programme.desc: Alina torna dalla Germania per prendere Voichita, l'unica persona che abbia mai amato e che mai amerà. Ma Voichita ha incontrato Dio e in amore, è molto difficile avere Dio come rivale.

programme.title: I'm Your Man
programme.desc: Alma è una scienziata del famoso Museo Pergamon di Berlino. Al fine di ottenere dei fondi per il suo lavoro di ricercatrice, si fa convincere a partecipare a uno studio alquanto particolare. Per tre settimane dovrà vivere con un robot umanoide creato su misura in base al suo carattere e ai suoi bisogni, e la cui intelligenza artificiale è progettata per essere il suo compagno di vita perfetto.

programme.title: THE ROMANTICS
programme.desc: Sette trentenni, compagni al college, si riuniscono dopo 6 anni per il matrimonio di Tom e Lila. La notte prima del matrimonio, Laura, damigella d'onore di Lila ed ex fiamma di Tom, e il promesso sposo scoprono di essere ancora innamorati.

programme.title: I'm Your Man
programme.desc: Alma è una scienziata del famoso Museo Pergamon di Berlino. Al fine di ottenere dei fondi per il suo lavoro di ricercatrice, si fa convincere a partecipare a uno studio alquanto particolare. Per tre settimane dovrà vivere con un robot umanoide creato su misura in base al suo carattere e ai suoi bisogni, e la cui intelligenza artificiale è progettata per essere il suo compagno di vita perfetto.

programme.title: East Is East
programme.desc: Nel 1971 George Khan, pakistano tradizionalista, è emigrato nel Regno Unito dove possiede un negozio di fish & chips e ha sposato Ella. I loro sette figli sembrano poco inclini a seguire le direttive paterne per quanto riguarda la religione islamica.

programme.title: Poeti dallinferno
programme.desc: Verlaine, poeta già affermato, legge i lavori del giovanissimo Rimbaud e ne coglie subito l'eccezionale valore. Quando conosce l'autore, se ne innamora perdutamente.

programme.title: Uno Anzi Due
programme.desc: Da quando suo padre è morto, Maurizio è sommerso dai debiti ma decide di nascondere tutto alla moglie e al figlio che sta per sposarsi. Un mare di debiti, bugie e malintesi nella commedia esilarante con Maurizio Battista e Claudia Pandolfi.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e lavorano nella redazione di un giornale satirico. Dado ha successo con le donne mentre Marco ha molti problemi, fin quando non arrivano Adele e Maria a cambiare le loro vite.

programme.title: Third Person
programme.desc: Tre storie di passione, fiducia e tradimento, che prendono vita in tre città diverse, dove si dipanano le vicende di tre coppie che sembrano non avere nulla in comune, se non un invisibile, flebile legame.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite, instillando l'amore, la sensibilità e la paura in chi ne viene colpito. In tale contesto, i giovani Nia e Silas vivranno sulla loro pelle i dilemmi generati da una relazione proibita.

programme.title: The Prince
programme.desc: La figlia di un killer ormai in pensione è rapita da un rivale, di quest'ultimo, che cerca vendetta. Infatti l'ex-killer è ritenuto dal rapitore colpevole della morte della sua amata moglie. Riuscirà l'ex killer a salvare la figlia da morte certa?

programme.title: Sicario: ultimo incarico
programme.desc: Un killer professionista, solitario, professionale, sicuro, nervi d'acciaio, deve saldare un debito in sospeso col suo mentore, accettando un nuovo incarico: trovare e uccidere la sua ultima preda, un suo collega, di cui non conosce né il volto né il nome.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.
